claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie estate covers 8 hectares with 5 historic buildings, 45 rooms/suites, 3 restaurants (one with 3 Michelin stars), spa, and 7 gardens; family-owned since 1974.
quote: The Estate covers 8 hectares and is made up of 5 Historic Buildings with 45 rooms and suites.

claim: Le Couvent des Herbes is an 18th-century building with romantic rustic rooms (poetic names like Jardin Secret, Belle Nonnette), waxed terracotta, canopy beds; Logis des Grives suites have antique beams and fireplaces.
quote: Charming suites blend rustic charm with refined elegance featuring antique beams and fireplaces.

claim: La Maison Rose is the estate's 3-star guesthouse: 8 rooms (21–25 m²) and 4 junior suites (28–30 m²) overlooking the Ferme aux Grives meadow, pool, or village; rooms in 'British countryside' tones.
quote: La Maison Rose has 8 rooms ranging from 21 to 25 m² ... 4 junior suites ranging from 28 to 30 m².

claim: Eugénie-les-Bains is in the Landes department; Aire-sur-l'Adour is 9 km south-east and Mont-de-Marsan 24 km away.
quote: Aire-sur-l'Adour at 9 km and Mont-de-Marsan at 24 km.

claim: Eugénie-les-Bains sits ~50 km from Pau and ~25 km from Mont-de-Marsan.
quote: Eugénie-les-Bains 50 km de Pau, 25 km de Mont-de-Marsan.

claim: Local taxi options for Eugénie/Aire include Taxis d'Eugénie (06 71 83 33 55, 7/7), Aire Taxi (06 07 48 77 31), Taxi Landes Passion (Bahus-Soubiran, 06 03 53 41 67), ABC Flo Taxi (Cazères-sur-Adour).
quote: Taxis d'Eugénie ... Aire Taxi ... Taxi Landes Passion ... ABC Flo Taxi.

claim: Aire Taxi advertises 24/7 service; same-day late-night transport is realistic only if booked at least 12 hours in advance.
quote: Aire Taxi service assured 24h/24 7J/7.

claim: Château de Lahitte (Vergoignan, Gers) is an 18th-century restored château B&B with 5 ensuite rooms, large outdoor pool, formal gardens, and Pyrenees views; near Michelin-starred Eugénie.
quote: Château de Lahitte was built in the 18th century and was originally a wine-producing property ... five guest rooms ... large outdoor swimming pool.

claim: Château de Lahitte receives consistently positive guest reviews on TripAdvisor, with praise for the grounds, pool and Pyrenees view from the gardens.
quote: Pleasant stay ... view on the hills of the Gers are stunning and the garden which surrounds the Chateau is lovely.

claim: Le Jardin sur l'Eau is a maison-de-maître B&B in central Aire-sur-l'Adour with parts dating to the Middle Ages; 3 rooms (Amélie, Justine, Charlotte), 2 apartments, gîte, garden pool; hosted by Juliette.
quote: Three comfortable guest rooms and a gîte for pilgrims ... beautiful mansion ... in direct vicinity of the thermal station with 3 Michelin stars restaurant.

claim: Le Jardin sur l'Eau scores 9.5/10 on Booking.com; 50 m from the UNESCO-listed Sainte-Quitterie church on the Compostela route.
quote: Booking.com 9.5/10 rating ... 10 minutes' walk from the Sainte Quitterie church.

claim: Domaine de Bassibé sits in Ségos (Gers/Landes border) on landscaped grounds with century-old oaks, pool, pétanque court and converted chai; operates as B&B and event/wedding venue; described as 'formerly Relais & Châteaux'.
quote: Authentic countryside estate ... renovated historic structure with exposed wooden beams ... Formerly a Relais & Châteaux property.

claim: Booking.com lists Domaine de Bassibé as a 17-room property with garden, terrace, outdoor pool, and Relais & Châteaux label; 24 mi from Pau Pyrénées Airport, 6.8 mi from Tursan Golf 'Eugénie's Greens'.
quote: 17 rooms equipped with modern amenities ... close to attractions such as The Tursan Golf Eugenie's Greens (6.8 mi).

claim: Maison d'hôtes Lassaubatju in Hontanx is run by Frédéric & Véronique on a multi-generation Armagnac estate; 3 rooms (Ortolan, Rapière, Part des Anges), park with pool and spa, cellar visits and tastings.
quote: Three guest rooms named Ortolan and Part des Anges in a family house surrounded by 15 hectares of vineyards. The family has been distilling Armagnac for generations.

claim: Lassaubatju 2026 rates: B&B for 2 from €88, table d'hôtes meal from €29; Wi-Fi, parking, bikes available; address 4 Route de Métier, 40190 Hontanx.
quote: B&B for 2 people: from €88 ... Meals: from €29.

claim: La Roseraie in Saint-Sever is a 1780 manor house with 1+ hectare of grounds and rare centenarian trees, 3 rooms incl. 2 suites (30 m²) furnished with antiques; facing the UNESCO Jacobin cloister.
quote: Grand mansion built in 1780, located in the heart of Saint-Sever ... surrounded by over 1 hectare of grounds ... 3 rooms, including 2 suites.

claim: Domaine de Paguy in Betbezer-d'Armagnac dates to 1567 (reign of Henri IV); estate of 77 ha including 13 ha of vines, wine cellar, 4–5 guest rooms with private baths, 12×6 m pool open June–October.
quote: Built in 1567 during the reign of Henri IV ... estate extends over more than 77 hectares, 13 of which are vines ... swimming pool 12x6 m.

claim: Domaine de Paguy is labelled by Gîtes de France in the Landes d'Armagnac.
quote: Chambre d'hôtes ... Domaine De Paguy ... Landes d'Armagnac.

claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie is a MICHELIN Guide-listed hotel in Eugénie-les-Bains; the on-site gourmet restaurant has held 3 Michelin stars since 1977.
quote: Les Prés d'Eugénie - Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel.

claim: Les Prés d'Eugénie is a Relais & Châteaux member since 1968 and has held the 'Palace de France' distinction since 2017.
quote: Relais & Châteaux since 1968 ... Palace de France distinction since 2017.

claim: The Guérard family owns Château de Bachen in Duhort-Bachen (Tursan vineyards, 25 ha), purchased by Michel Guérard in 1983; the 13th/17th-c château welcomes visitors by appointment.
quote: In 1983, chef Michel Guérard purchased Château de Bachen ... domain spans 25 hectares.

claim: La Maison Rose is officially registered as a hotel in Eugénie-les-Bains by the Landes regional tourism guide.
quote: La Maison Rose - Hotels in Eugénie-les-Bains - Guide des Landes.
